Portfolio plan · November 2026

From prototype to production

What should an early portfolio demonstrate for customer-facing AI delivery, and how would that evidence differ for applied AI research?

Working direction

Prioritize a tested workflow with a clear user, a documented decision, and an explicit handoff when the system cannot answer.

Mayo Clinic job description ↗

Two career directions

These postings illustrate how teams define success. The portfolio plan uses that distinction to choose which skills to demonstrate first.

First direction

Customer-facing AI delivery

OpenAI emphasizes adoption and workflow impact. Mayo Clinic adds an industry example where human review and monitoring matter.

Show: a usable workflow, a tradeoff explained in writing, a simple baseline, and a handoff. This extends existing web and analytics work with user validation and operational checks.

Alternative

Model-focused applied science

Amazon emphasizes verifiable training tasks and evidence that training improves model capabilities.

Show: a reproducible experiment, a baseline, and an analysis of failures. This provides deeper experimental evidence and calls for more model-training practice.

Assumptions. The three postings are examples of experienced roles. The short-term goal is to demonstrate transferable skills through a small project. Current application acceptance was unconfirmed. Scoping, coding, and rollout are established software work. In these AI examples, evaluation also checks model behavior on the task and when human review is needed.

Portfolio plan

For a technical hiring manager, this portfolio makes it easy to see the problem, my contribution, and the evidence, then open the strongest case study.

A recruiter is the alternate reader and would benefit from a shorter skills summary. The hiring manager takes priority because this plan tests whether a reader can trace the work to a source or check.

Selected concept

Evidence-first portfolio

Voice: precise, practical, candid. Archetype: the guide. Use clear headings and a repeated problem → decision → check structure.

Adapt the constrained reading width and responsive grid from the GOV.UK layout guide. The repeated structure makes comparison easier and gives each story a similar visual weight.

Alternate concept

Annotated field notebook

Voice: curious, direct, reflective. Archetype: the explorer. Open on a project decision and place dated evidence alongside the story.

Adapt the dated observations from the Smithsonian field book. The format gives more space to process and requires more reading. Both concepts use the same introduction, cases, and “Inspect evidence” action.

  • GenConnect ↗Help a student locate a representative and reach an official resource. Show one search and how the result was checked against an official source.
  • Maintenance analytics ↗Turn synthetic maintenance requests into a usable operations summary. Trace one KPI through the SQL and Python workflow and label the data as synthetic.
  • Python calculator ↗Show how a command-line tool handles errors. Distinguish starter code from changes, then document expected and observed behavior for division by zero.

Use direct links to artifacts and concrete checks to establish credibility. State the limits beside each claim, including synthetic data, starter code, and any test that remains pending.

What to test next

Build one small source-grounded workflow for a public-information task. Compare its decisions with a manual lookup baseline using synthetic inputs.

Prototype acceptance check

Prepare 10 cases before implementation. Expect seven supported answers to cite an official source and three unsupported inputs to route to human review. Record expected and observed results for every case.

Status. Planned. The prototype check is pending.

Source and peer verification

AI helped find candidate sources, draft paraphrases, and structure the site. Responsibilities, qualifications, and dates were checked against the employer descriptions. The career direction and project choices are planning judgments.

Partner task. Trace Mayo Clinic’s role to the proposed human-review check. Record the first point where the evidence or expected behavior becomes unclear, with the page and a suggested change.
